opening.argument: The walkthrough shows a contributor account and image submission process, with instructions to upload original photos or videos and configure a payout method. The speaker tells viewers their work must be their own, while the visible submission screen shows an image selected with fields for its usage and keywords. A contributor dashboard also shows upload controls and a referral-reward banner. That banner does not establish that a referral link was shared, what its terms were, or any deceptive conduct. The earnings example remains an unverified report about a friend, not proof of an outcome. Taken together, the observable material supports an instructional account-and-upload demonstration, not a request for payment or credentials from an unknown recipient.
